curation.name: Velocity Walk Run2
curation.summary: Self-trained perpetual walking policy on Mjlab-Velocity-Flat-MicroDuck (run1 plus resume, 8749 checkpoint iterations) that runs until told otherwise.
curation.details: Standing-entry policy with an unused zero command block. Upstream metadata declares no license and the manifest omits action_scale, so installation and reuse need maintainer review.
curation.notes: The package manifest is resolved and inspected; action_scale is undeclared and upstream metadata declares no license. The registry records no independent hardware evidence.

publisher_hardware.note: The publisher reports a self-trained walking policy with no physical MicroDuck deployment evidence.
